profile.headline: A life in software
profile.summary:
A seasoned software architect/engineer with a career spanning over 25 years, Kris has a broad range of technical expertise. He is passionate about FOSS and has contributed to popular web frameworks, tools and techniques. 

Most recently he worked on a full-stack Javascript development project with Node.js, React, Redux, and MongoDB. He is also interested in building more software using micro / nano-services, uni-directional data architecture style, Docker, and uni-kernels.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
2022-present P4 Cloud
* Azure marketplace offer integration
* DevOps - Terraform design, automation using Github actions and Scalr
* BizOps - full-stack product development using Golang, TypeScript (node)

2016-2022 Gliffy Diagramming Software
* Full stack development using Ember.js
* Java (Play Framework), Node.js 
* Kubernetes deployments using Helm
positions.insights: Skills: Scalr · Next.js · Microsoft Azure · Go (Programming Language) · TypeScript · Architectural Design · Terraform

positions.title: Software Engineer - Full Stack
positions.description:
Education startup with focus on student assessment, progress and placement.

- Developed product application prototypes.
- Principal engineering in full-stack Javascript using Node.js, React.js and Redux.
- Deployment using Docker containers.

positions.title: Co Founder/CTO
positions.description:
Marketplace for Creative Freelancers.

- Principal engineering in full-stack Javascript, Node.js (Sails.js API), Ember-CLI (Ember.js), and PostgreSQL.
- Travis CI, Docker container deployments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
PBWorks provides a professional wiki platform to businesses and education, hosting over one million team workspaces, serving millions of users every day.

- Performed full-stack application development using Scrum methodology, and CI with Jenkins.
- Maintained a massive PHP monolith and migrated some features into node.js.
- Championed front-end feature migration to Backbone.js.
- Implemented many new user-facing features using Backbone.js.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Applications for Commercial real estate brokers.

- Built prototype for sales lifecycle support, including team income distribution.
- Tech Stack: Ruby-on-Rails, JQuery, MongoDB, Heroku

positions.title: Software Developer, (Remote Contract)
positions.description:
Internet startup incubator and holding company specializing in telephone-based interactive voice response (IVR) integration products.

- Developed Asterisk telephony applications using C#.net (Workflow Foundation), Ruby-on-Rails, RabbitMQ and RAGI.
- Coded features for the Telesign 2-factor authentication product.
- Designed and Developed working prototypes for Doctors-On-Demand scheduling product.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description:
NewMo specializes in collecting market data for fabless manufacturers (electronics components and medical) and provided our customers with a robust web-based analytics product to enable production compliance enforcement.

- Developing market and supply chain risk analysis and research tools (Web UI).
- Built a web scraping farm that navigated complex web UIs using MSMQ and Workflow Foundation, included digital screenshots of web pages for legal case books.
- Built distributed workflow for collecting high entropy web data, search engines, OLAP (Online Analytical Processing), 
- Deployed Microsoft Windows Server Platform and .Net 3.5 technologies (LINQ, WCF+WF).

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Coding in Microsoft .Net using C#, with a focus on massive-scale web development.

positions.title: Intranet Director
positions.description: line-of-business applications in Microsoft SharePoint Services 2003, and back-office integrations using BizTalk Server 2004.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: XML Web Services developed in .Net and Java for ERP integration with various fortune clients.

positions.title: Software Architect Engineer
positions.description: Online B2B Marketplace application where small businesses connected in real-time in well-established business communities.

positions.title: Software Engineer, IT Manager
positions.description:
Online 3D games using VRML and Java developed for contemporary entertainment products.
Games included: Xena Warrior Princess TV Show promo, The Fifth Element taxi game, Spawn Movie game, Lost in Space movie game, among others.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description: DisneyBlast premium children’s site featured online comic books, word games, crossword puzzles and many other features.  This was the first subscription-based internet destination that wasn't pornography and made a profit after the first year of investment.  DisneyBlast was also one of the first commercial sites to feature the majority of it's content using Macromedia Flash technology.

projects.title: Sane stack
projects.description: A Javascript Fullstack and CLI that lets you rapidly create production-ready web apps using Sails and Ember. Get Docker support, generators and more.
